prompt:
Image 1 is the painting style reference only; do not copy its scenery.
Image 2 is the character design of CHENG CHE (the man, keep his face and eyes; short slightly messy black hair); in this picture CHENG CHE is about 45 years old.
Image 3 is the character design of CHENG ZHEN (their daughter, keep her face and eyes); in this picture CHENG ZHEN is about 17 years old.
Image 4 is the character design of THE SENIOR BOY (keep his face, glasses and hair); in this picture THE SENIOR BOY is about 18 years old.

Scene: a family dining table at dinner, dishes of home
cooking. From left to right along the far side of the table: THE SENIOR BOY, then CHENG ZHEN, then CHENG CHE (45). THE SENIOR BOY sits
very straight, eyes down, holding his rice bowl in his left hand and chopsticks in his right, eating carefully. CHENG CHE sits with a
stern serious face, arms folded. CHENG ZHEN, between them, hides a laugh: hands written exactly, her right hand covers her mouth, her
left hand rests flat on the table beside her rice bowl; her chopsticks lie across the top of her bowl, not in her hand. Every hand in
the picture belongs to one of these three people and connects to their own arm. The mother's seat is at the near edge, out of frame.

Painting style: delicate transparent watercolor on textured cold-press paper, exactly like image 1: pale luminous washes, soft natural light, loose soft wet edges, visible paper grain, unpainted white paper areas. Hand-painted watercolor illustration, not anime cel shading, not 3D, not photo.
Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Keep all important subjects and faces in the upper two thirds of the frame; the bottom third should be calm, low-detail ground or background (a text box will cover it). People do not look at the viewer unless stated. Correct anatomy: each hand has exactly five fingers, left and right hands on the correct sides; any hand not described is hidden out of view. Modern everyday objects look plain and timeless, nothing futuristic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no signage, no watermark.
